description: What is left before RTE 1.0: milestones, tracks and priorities. The plan is docs/ROADMAP.md.

milestones.title: 0.1.0-alpha.5
milestones.description: Stable base: the API surface and editing rules reviewed and written down, one error model, one content policy, read-only and disabled states complete.

milestones.title: 0.2.0-beta.0
milestones.description: Measure and gate: a benchmark suite with a stated method, numeric budgets, memory and leak tests, and CI gates for size and speed.

milestones.title: 0.3.0-beta.0
milestones.description: Platforms and accessibility: server rendering, touch, input methods, screen readers, the keyboard and contrast audit, language packs, the browser support window and clipboard completeness.

milestones.title: 0.4.0-beta.0
milestones.description: Content features: formatting decisions, links and anchors, image upload, code blocks, table properties, lists and collapsible sections.

milestones.title: 0.5.0-beta.0
milestones.description: Interface and modes: toolbar configuration, consistent dialogs, the suggestion popup and range decorations, editing modes, the textarea upgrade, and embeds (phase 1).

milestones.title: 0.6.0-beta.0
milestones.description: Speed and size met: typing cost independent of document size, very large documents, load throughput, a smaller core, lazy interface parts.

milestones.title: 0.7.0-beta.0
milestones.description: Adoption kit: migration guide and tool, content profiles, the script-tag build, starters, a playground, the reference server and the decision on mappings.

milestones.title: 0.8.0-beta.0
milestones.description: Frozen surface: the plugin API frozen, the API reference, guides, the support and deprecation policy, and the compatibility check between releases.

milestones.title: 1.0.0-rc.1
milestones.description: Release candidate: security review, fuzzing, property tests, the accessibility conformance report, a soak test, reproducible builds, the alpha-only release rules lifted, two weeks with no new P0.

tracks.behavior: Editing rules, the API contract and the clipboard
tracks.features: What people can write and make
tracks.interface: Toolbars, dialogs, modes and plugin hooks for the interface

issues.title: Review the public exports of every package
issues.body:
List what each of the eleven packages exports, remove accidental exports, name things consistently, and check every exported type has a doc comment.

Done when: an export snapshot is checked in and CI fails on an unreviewed change.

issues.title: Define the editor event and options contract
issues.body:
Audit the events (`change`, `ready`, focus, blur, selection) and options (placeholder, max length, read-only, autofocus, spellcheck, direction) across the core, the element and each wrapper. Same names, same timing, same payloads, documented once.

Done when: one table in the docs covers every option and event for every package, and a test per wrapper checks it.

issues.title: Audit undo and redo
issues.body:
Check grouping of typing, one step per command, selection restore, the history limit, undo across plugin repairs (footnotes), across paste and across IME input.

Done when: a written rule list and a test per rule; no known case where undo leaves the document in a state no edit produced.

issues.title: Audit selection and caret rules
issues.body:
Atoms (images, footnote references), cell boundaries, quotes, code blocks, list items, right-to-left text, select-all, double and triple click, shift-arrow extension, caret before and after a block-level atom.

Done when: a rule list with a browser check for each, in all three engines.

issues.title: Audit Enter, Shift+Enter, Backspace and Delete at block edges
issues.body:
Every block type and nesting: list items (including an empty last child, which should exit the item), quotes, code, table cells, notes, headings, around atoms.

Done when: a table of expected results is in the docs and each row is a test.

issues.title: Complete and document the content filtering policy
issues.body:
One page that states the allowed elements, attributes and style properties, URL schemes, nesting depth, input size limits, how unknown elements are handled, and what is kept or dropped on load versus paste. Add a configuration profile for stricter or looser hosts.

Done when: the page matches the code (a test reads the policy tables), and hostile-markup tests cover each rule.

issues.title: Write the error and warning model
issues.body:
What the editor does with bad input (invalid HTML, bad options, a failing plugin, a failing upload): never throw on content, one `warn` channel with codes, plugin failures isolated.

Done when: documented, with tests for a throwing plugin and for malformed content.

issues.title: Read-only and disabled states
issues.body:
Read-only keeps selection and copy and blocks every edit path (commands, typing, paste, drop, cut, spellcheck replacements, plugin commands). Disabled also leaves the tab order.

Done when: one browser check walks every input path in both states.

issues.title: Benchmark suite and method
issues.body:
A fixed benchmark harness: load, typing, paste, undo, large tables, memory, cold start, run on a stated machine class with a stated method, reproducible by anyone from the repo.

Done when: results and method are in `docs/MEASUREMENTS.md` and a CI job runs a reduced version.

issues.title: Write the budgets
issues.body:
Set numeric budgets after the baseline: bytes per entry point, keystroke latency at 1,000 and 10,000 paragraphs, load time, memory per undo step, cold start. Decision with a recommendation from the baseline. The targets may also be informed by measurements kept outside this repository; the docs publish only our own numbers and methods.

Done when: the numbers are in the docs and in `package.json` budgets or the benchmark config.

issues.title: Memory and leaks
issues.body:
Create and destroy the editor thousands of times with every plugin and wrapper, with no growth; per-step undo cost stays within budget.

Done when: a leak test runs in CI in three engines.

issues.title: Regression gates in CI
issues.body:
Fail a change that grows any budgeted number beyond a stated margin, with a way to record an approved increase.

Done when: a deliberate regression in a test branch fails CI.

issues.title: Throttled-CPU and low-memory runs
issues.body:
Extend the 4× CPU slowdown runs to mobile-class settings and add a low-memory run.

Done when: numbers are in `docs/MEASUREMENTS.md`.

issues.title: Decide how performance is described publicly
issues.body:
Owner decision: the docs state only measured numbers with methods; any statement that compares with other products waits for a benchmark anyone can run, and for the owner's rule on naming other products.

Done when: the rule is written in `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the site copy follows it.

issues.title: Benchmarks in their own repository, run in a container
issues.body:
The benchmark runner, its container recipe and the method live in the public repository rathkit/rte-bench, and a benchmark is run only inside an isolated, throwaway container (image pinned by digest, no network during the run). This repository keeps the published results in docs/MEASUREMENTS.md with a link, the numbers the project holds itself to (budgets, the recorded sizes, the approved increases), and the test-only manifest of the browser driver the browser checks need. The same pattern as the Rathkit Pack bundler, so one set of rules serves both.

Done when: (1) rathkit/rte-bench holds the runner, a container recipe pinned by digest and the method, and docs/MEASUREMENTS.md links to it; (2) this repository holds no benchmark runner, and the only third-party code the benchmarks load, the browser driver, stays in tools/browser-checks as the test-only manifest, because the browser checks need it as well (no other tool is compared with, in either repository); (3) a published figure is made only inside the container and names the browser build, the machine, the load and the commits of both repositories; (4) the regression gate of 3.4 still fails a deliberate regression in a test branch, with the runner taken from rte-bench at a pinned commit; (5) the plan's open points are settled with the owner before this closes.

issues.title: Server-side use and server rendering
issues.body:
Model, import and export run in Node with no DOM. Wrappers and the element render a safe placeholder on the server and attach on the client. Checks with a real Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit and Angular server-rendered app.

Done when: each of the four renders and hydrates with no warning and no mismatch, and the docs say how to use each.

issues.title: Touch and mobile pass
issues.body:
Soft keyboards, selection handles, long-press menus, the toolbar on narrow screens, tap targets of at least 24 px, orientation change. Real devices: iOS Safari and an Android Chromium browser.

Done when: the steps in `docs/HAND-TESTING.md` are run on both, the results are in `docs/SUPPORT.md`, and the findings are fixed or listed.

issues.title: Input method (IME) pass
issues.body:
Composition in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit for Japanese, Chinese and Korean input, plus Android keyboards: no lost text, no broken undo, composition over marks, atoms and cell edges.

Done when: a scripted composition check runs in the three engines and hand results are recorded.

issues.title: Screen reader pass
issues.body:
NVDA and JAWS on Windows, VoiceOver on macOS and iOS, TalkBack on Android: the editing surface, toolbar, menus, dialogs, tables, lists, footnotes and live announcements.

Done when: results are recorded per reader in `docs/SUPPORT.md` and every blocking finding is fixed.

issues.title: Keyboard, contrast, motion and zoom audit
issues.body:
Every function reachable by keyboard with a visible focus, forced-colors and high-contrast themes, reduced motion, 400% zoom and 320 px reflow, WCAG 2.2 AA target size and contrast, no keyboard trap.

Done when: an audit checklist is in the repo with a result per item, and failures are fixed.

issues.title: Localization: stable message ids and language packs
issues.body:
Messages keyed by stable ids with an English fallback, a pack format, lazy loading, plural rules, mirrored interface for right-to-left, and a tool that reports missing or unused keys in a pack.

Done when: two non-English packs ship in the repo (as tests, not a promise of translations) and the completeness tool runs in CI.

issues.title: Published compatibility matrix
issues.body:
Browser, framework and Node versions with the result of the last full run, generated from CI so it cannot drift.

Done when: in `docs/SUPPORT.md` and on the site, generated.

issues.title: Browser support window and older engines
issues.body:
Decide the support window (current and previous versions of Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, plus iOS and Android), test the oldest supported version in CI where possible, and say what happens below it.

Done when: the window is in `docs/SUPPORT.md` and enforced by a CI job or a feature check with a clear message.

issues.title: Clipboard completeness
issues.body:
Copy, cut, drag out and drop in: which formats are written and read (HTML, plain text, opt-in Markdown, files), large-paste limits, paste inside a code block, inside a table cell range, and between two editors on the same page.

Done when: a matrix of source × target is in the docs and covered by browser checks.

issues.title: Grow the scrubbed paste captures
issues.body:
More captures of word processors, online document editors, spreadsheets, mail and web pages, scrubbed and checked by `pnpm check:fixtures`. Keep the current conformance results from falling.

Done when: the capture set doubles and the free-tier scenarios still all pass in three engines.

issues.title: Decide font family and font size
issues.body:
Owner decision with a recommendation: allow font family and size as allow-listed values (a host-defined list, not arbitrary CSS), or leave them to host styles. Write the decision in the docs.

Done when: the decision is recorded; if yes, build it under the next issue.

issues.title: Complete the link flows
issues.body:
Link dialog (address, text, title, new tab, relationship), quick edit and remove from the caret, auto-link on paste and typing, address check with a clear message, link to a heading or anchor, and the URL policy as an option.

Done when: every flow is in the docs and in browser checks.

issues.title: Image upload flow and editing
issues.body:
Upload tab and drag position in the dialog, progress and error states, cancel, retry, alt-text requirement option, caption editing, figure handling, paste of images, responsive attributes, and lazy loading in output.

Done when: it works against a loopback test server and the host contract is documented.

issues.title: Code blocks: language and highlighting
issues.body:
Language attribute and menu, a tab-key policy, copy button option, and an opt-in syntax highlighting plugin with a small built-in tokenizer set (no dependencies) that other tokenizers can be added to.

Done when: size budget kept, highlight output is plain classes that a theme can style, tested.

issues.title: Tables: properties and accessibility
issues.body:
Caption, header column, header scope, cell alignment (horizontal and vertical), table width and alignment, row and column move, equalize widths, paste of a cell range, and nested tables behavior defined.

Done when: documented in `docs/TABLES.md`, each feature tested, and a table passes a structure check for accessibility.

issues.title: Block style presets
issues.body:
A host-defined list of named block and inline styles (a class name, a label, which blocks it applies to) in a menu, written as a class, validated against the list on load and paste.

Done when: documented, tested, and a class not in the list is dropped.

issues.title: Font family and font size marks
issues.body:
If decided yes: marks with a host-defined list of values, toolbar menus, HTML and Markdown behavior, paste handling (values outside the list map to the nearest or are dropped).

Done when: documented, tested in three engines.

issues.title: Named anchors and heading ids
issues.body:
Insert and edit anchors, stable ids for headings, an option to generate them, anchor links in the link dialog, and a table-of-contents helper that reads the document model.

Done when: round-trips through HTML and is documented.

issues.title: Collapsible sections
issues.body:
A `details` and `summary` block: insert, edit the summary, open and close in the editor, keyboard and screen reader behavior, HTML in and out.

Done when: documented and tested, with a decision on nesting.

issues.title: List polish
issues.body:
Enter on an empty last child exits the item, list style and start-number controls in the interface, checklist toggling by keyboard, and list behavior inside quotes and table cells.

Done when: each is a test.

issues.title: Decide the extra inline elements
issues.body:
Which of `kbd`, `abbr`, `q`, `cite`, `small`, `mark` and `del`/`ins` become marks. Write down the decision and keep the rest as text.

Done when: the list is in the content filtering page and implemented.

issues.title: Find and replace extras
issues.body:
Wrap-around, search inside the selection, optional accent folding, live count announcements.

Done when: documented, tested, announcements checked with a screen reader.

issues.title: Toolbar configuration and responsive layout
issues.body:
Choose, order and group items, an overflow menu on narrow widths, a sticky option, per-item visibility by state, and custom items from a plugin.

Done when: a documented configuration object covers all of it and works in the element and in each wrapper.

issues.title: Dialogs: one consistent behavior
issues.body:
Focus trap or inert background, return of focus, validation messages, error text, Escape and Enter rules, read-only behavior, responsive size.

Done when: one browser check suite runs against every dialog.

issues.title: Range decoration API
issues.body:
A public way for a plugin to draw over ranges without changing the document (the way find does with CSS highlights), with a position that follows edits.

Done when: find uses the public API and the docs show a second example.

issues.title: Editing modes: inline, single-line and plain-text
issues.body:
A mode with no block structure (inline text with marks), a single-line mode for short fields, and a plain-text mode that still gives find, counts and paste cleaning.

Done when: each mode is an option on the standard editor, the element and each wrapper.

issues.title: Textarea upgrade path
issues.body:
A helper that upgrades a `textarea` or a `div` with HTML into an editor and keeps the original field's name, form value and validation, and can destroy back to the original.

Done when: tested with a native form, in three engines.

issues.title: Suggestion popup primitive
issues.body:
A generic popup for `@`-style completion that a plugin drives from `textTrigger`: anchored to the caret, keyboard and screen reader behavior, async results.

Done when: a sample mention plugin in the docs uses only public API.

issues.title: Fullscreen, print and export
issues.body:
Fullscreen toggle, print styles, and export of HTML, plain text and (with the Markdown plugin) Markdown from a documented call.

Done when: documented and tested.

issues.title: Embeds, phase 1 (opt-in plugin)
issues.body:
Build `docs/EMBEDS.md` phase 1: the `embed` block, provider presets, insert command and dialog, paste of a recognized address, normalize step, placeholder card, hostile-input corpus.

Done when: every rule in `docs/EMBEDS.md` has a test and the docs show the CSP line.

issues.title: Keystroke cost independent of document size
issues.body:
Make typing, Enter and formatting cost proportional to the changed block, not the document: incremental redraw, per-block caches, no whole-document scans on edit.

Done when: typing latency at 10,000 paragraphs is within the budget and a test fails if it grows with size.

issues.title: Shrink the core
issues.body:
Measure with the real minifier, find dead and duplicate code, make sure each entry point is side-effect free and tree-shakes, and move rarely used code to a plugin.

Done when: core and core-plus-view sizes meet the new budgets and a test checks tree-shaking per entry point.

issues.title: Very large documents
issues.body:
Defer drawing of blocks far from the viewport while keeping find, select-all, and print correct; define the supported size and warn beyond it.

Done when: a 50,000-paragraph document loads and scrolls within budget.

issues.title: Load and import throughput
issues.body:
Remove any quadratic step in parse, import, export and Markdown; chunk long loads; measure with the largest fixtures.

Done when: load time grows linearly in a test across four sizes.

issues.title: Lazy loading of interface parts
issues.body:
Load dialogs, menus, the emoji and special-character data, and syntax tokenizers on first use; measure time to first interaction.

Done when: the first-paint bundle shrinks by the amount stated in the budget and lazy parts work offline.

issues.title: Style cost
issues.body:
Count style recalculations and layout passes during typing and toolbar updates; remove thrash; keep the stylesheet within budget.

Done when: measured before and after in `docs/MEASUREMENTS.md`.

issues.title: Migration guide
issues.body:
A guide for moving an existing integration: how options, content and plugins map to RTE, written without naming other products (decision on where product-specific mappings live is open).

Done when: a team can follow it on a sample app.

issues.title: Content migration tool
issues.body:
A command-line and library tool that reads a folder or a list of stored HTML, converts it to the editor's normalized HTML, and reports what would change or be dropped, without writing anything unless asked.

Done when: dry run and write modes tested on a corpus of mixed HTML, zero dependencies.

issues.title: Script-tag build
issues.body:
A single-file build for pages without a bundler, from `rathkit-pack`, with integrity hashes and a documented CDN URL pattern.

Done when: a page with one script tag works offline and the file size is in the budget list.

issues.title: Content filtering profiles for legacy content
issues.body:
Named profiles (strict, standard, permissive) so existing stored content loads without loss where it is safe, with a report of what each profile drops.

Done when: each profile documented and tested against the corpus.

issues.title: Compatibility layer, if decided
issues.body:
If the decision above says yes: an adapter that accepts a familiar options shape and returns an RTE instance, kept outside the zero-dependency core.

Done when: shipped where the decision says, with its own tests.

issues.title: Starter templates and examples
issues.body:
Vanilla, React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, jQuery, Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, and a server-rendered form (Rails, Django, Laravel).

Done when: each builds and passes a smoke check in CI.

issues.title: Reference server package (rte-server)
issues.body:
`rte-server` is part of 1.0 (decided by the maintainer). Publish `@rathkit/rte-server` with zero runtime dependencies: the upload and link-check contract as a written specification, a reference implementation of both, and the server-side clean-up an HTML value needs before it is stored. It is a reference to build on, not a hosted service.

Done when: the package is published, its contract is documented, a sample server in the docs runs against it, and tests cover the contract.

issues.title: Interactive playground
issues.body:
A page on the site that runs the editor with live options, plugin toggles, the HTML output, and a link that shares a configuration.

Done when: it loads from the published packages only and works offline.

issues.title: One-package install
issues.body:
Decide on a meta-package that re-exports the standard editor and element, and document the install lines for each stack.

Done when: decision recorded and, if yes, shipped.

issues.title: Contribution guide for plugins
issues.body:
How to write, test, size-check and propose a plugin; the review checklist.

Done when: in `CONTRIBUTING.md` with a sample plugin.

issues.title: Decide how product-specific mappings are offered
issues.body:
Owner decision: the repository rule forbids naming other products. Choose where option mappings and a compatibility layer can live (private package, separate repository, paid migration kit) and who maintains them.

Done when: decision recorded.

issues.title: Freeze the plugin API for beta
issues.body:
Review every member of `PluginHost` and the hook types (`view`, `normalize`, `importOptions`, `pasteTransform`, `fileHandler`, `ui`). Mark each stable or experimental, remove what has no user, and write the compatibility rule that `PLUGIN_API_VERSION` follows.

Done when: `docs/PLUGINS.md` lists every member with its status, the rule is in `docs/RELEASING.md`, and a test fails when a stable member changes shape.

issues.title: Public API compatibility check
issues.body:
Compare the exported API of the new build with the last release and fail on an unlisted breaking change.

Done when: the check runs in CI and in the release workflow.

issues.title: API reference
issues.body:
Generated from the types at build time and published on the site: every export, option, command, event and plugin hook, with examples that are run as tests.

Done when: complete, searchable, and linked from every package README.

issues.title: Guides and recipes
issues.body:
Custom plugin, custom toolbar, theming, upload endpoint, content security policy setup, forms and validation, server rendering, accessibility notes, saving and loading.

Done when: each recipe has code that is checked by a test.

issues.title: Support, deprecation and version policy
issues.body:
How long a major version is supported, how deprecations are announced and removed, what a patch may change, and how security fixes are backported.

Done when: published in `docs/RELEASING.md` and on the site.

issues.title: Stability policy for the options, events and plugin API
issues.body:
Which options, events, commands, hooks and CSS tokens are covered by the 1.0 promise, which are experimental, and how a change is announced.

Done when: published in `docs/RELEASING.md` and enforced by the API compatibility check.

issues.title: Independent security review
issues.body:
An outside review of import, sanitization, paste, SVG cleaning, embeds, Markdown and the build pipeline, with a written report and fixes for every high finding.

Done when: the report is summarized in `SECURITY.md` and no high finding is open.

issues.title: Fuzzing in CI
issues.body:
Coverage-guided or grammar-based fuzzing of HTML import, Markdown, SVG cleaning and URL handling, with a corpus in the repo and a nightly run.

Done when: it runs nightly and has run for two weeks without a crash.

issues.title: Property tests for the model
issues.body:
Properties over random edits: undo and redo invert, normalization is idempotent, export then import is stable, selection stays valid.

Done when: run in CI with a fixed seed set and a nightly random seed.

issues.title: Accessibility conformance statement
issues.body:
A WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report for the standard editor and the styled interface, from the audit and the screen reader results, with known gaps listed.

Done when: published and linked from the docs.

issues.title: Reproducible build check
issues.body:
Build the packages twice in clean environments and compare the tarballs, so the published files can be verified from source.

Done when: a CI job fails on a difference.

issues.title: Long-session soak test
issues.body:
Eight hours of scripted typing, formatting and undo with memory and latency sampled.

Done when: memory and latency stay flat and the run is repeatable.

issues.title: Copyright holder, trademark notice and security contact
issues.body:
The copyright holder in `NOTICE` after the assignment to the company, trademark notices, and the security contact and policy.

Done when: the owner closes it.

issues.title: Release candidate cycle: two weeks with no new P0
issues.body:
Run the full suite, the hand-testing script and the soak test on the candidate; only fixes land; a second candidate is cut for any change.

Done when: two weeks with no open blocker and a recorded sign-off.

issues.title: Lift the alpha-only release rules
issues.body:
Change `tools/check-release.mjs`, `check:packages`, the `next` dist-tag rule and the README and site notices so a stable version is allowed and published to `latest`.

Done when: a dry run of a stable tag passes every check.

issues.title: 1.0.0 release
issues.body:
Release notes, the `latest` tag moves, site and README say stable, and the support policy takes effect.

Done when: published and verified in an empty project.

issues.title: After 1.0: the next roadmap
issues.body:
Collect what was deferred (collaboration, comments, native wrappers, media) into a new set of milestones.

Done when: the next roadmap is in the repository.

issues.title: Announcement and the what-is-tested statement
issues.body:
Draft the announcement and a plain statement of what is tested (browsers, devices, screen readers, framework versions) and what is not.

Done when: the statement is on the site and in `docs/SUPPORT.md`, and the owner has approved the announcement.
